Subject: POC: scope & next steps - Acme Corp

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're all aligned: 

High-level agreed scope (initial):
- 1 production-like POC for customer support triage (classification + routing)
- Evaluation window: 4 weeks (pilot traffic + synthetic prompts)
- Success criteria: 85% routing accuracy on sampled tickets; end-to-end latency < 300ms p95

Proposed timeline & owners:
- Week 0 (this week): sign SOW and share evaluation checklist (owner: Marissa) — attached POC-SOW-v1.pdf, evaluation-checklist.xlsx
- Week 1: infra & access setup (owner: Vivek)
- Week 2-5: evaluation runs and weekly checkpoints (owner: Sam)
- Week 6: results review and decision (owner: Sam/Acme)

Open items / asks for you:
1) Confirm the success criteria above (routing accuracy and latency) or flag changes
2) Confirm the set of sample ticket types (can you share a short sample set?)
3) Sign SOW v1 or confirm edits — I attached the current version

If you want to add additional use cases (e.g., summarization for agent responses), that's fine but we should rebaseline the timeline and success criteria. Can we tentatively schedule a 30-min rebaseline call if you want to add scope? 

Proposed times: Tue 6/30 10am PT or Wed 7/1 2pm PT. Let me know what works.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0124

Attachments: POC-SOW-v1.pdf, evaluation-checklist.xlsx

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the summary. A few updates from our side after internal review: 

1) Additional use case: we want to include an email summarization flow for escalated tickets (short summaries for managers). This wasn't in the original plan but it's a high priority for Q3.
2) Adjusted success criteria request: for summarization we want extractive+abstractive summaries that match manager expectations ~80% of the time (we can provide 50 sample tickets and scoring rubric).
3) Timeline impact: adding this will likely push the evaluation window by ~2 weeks depending on setup complexity.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can include summarization in the same POC run, and if so what additional telemetry / dataset samples you'll need? Also please provide an updated SOW if the scope change requires it.

We're happy to do a rebaseline call — Tue 6/30 10am PT works for Priya and me.

Thanks,
Sam Turner
Director, Customer Support Systems
Acme Corp
sam.turner@acmecorp.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-26T11:22:00Z
Subject: Re: POC: scope & next steps - Acme Corp

Thanks Sam — this is helpful. Short answers and plan: 

- Yes, we can include the email summarization use case in the same POC. It will be treated as a second evaluation track with its own success criteria.
- For summarization we'll need: 
  * 50-100 sample escalated emails labeled with desired summary length and a short rubric (send as CSV/Google Sheet)
  * A small set of evaluation prompts and a human scoring template (we can share ours and adapt)
  * Expected SLOs (e.g., 80% quality threshold as you suggested)

Impact to timeline:
- Proposed revised evaluation window: 6 weeks (adds ~2 weeks)
- New timeline milestones: setup (week 0-1), run (week 2-7), results (week 8)

I've attached an updated draft SOW (POC-SOW-v2.pdf) that reflects the additional use case and proposed timelines. Vivek — can you confirm infra/telemetry needs and whether we need a separate staging workspace for the summarization track?

Rishi — I'll need you to oversee the commercial implications (pricing delta, updated deal plan) and sign off on the new SOW once we agree. Lauren, looping you in for visibility on scope creep and approval process.

Next steps:
- Sam/Priya: confirm sample deliverables and that Tue 6/30 10am PT still works for rebaseline call
- Vivek: comment on infra ask by EOD 6/27
- Rishi: comment on commercial by 6/28

Thanks — Marissa

Attachments: POC-SOW-v2.pdf
